stem:
Read these lines from the poem.

What a treasure to own!
My own flesh, my own feelings.

Which sentence from the story relates a similar idea?

options.label: F
options.text: Janis had seemed so confident, but she was just as self-conscious as me.

options.label: G
options.text: This was because I had never been part of any particular group.

options.label: H
options.text: Behind my drum set was the one place I felt completely like myself.

options.label: J
options.text: It was the perfect place to practice my drumming without anyone bothering me or judging me.

visual_elements: My own flesh, my own feelings.
